_comment: Qualitative cells for the 9 EU footprint countries' rows in the dashboard per-country card. The NUMBERS (ATMs/branches/cash + YoY) are derived automatically by ingest.py from the scripted ECB series (structural_series.json); only these slow-changing text cells (instant-payment scheme status + Printec implication) live here so they survive without being hand-typed into the findings file each month. Update only when a scheme status or strategic read materially changes. Keyed by ISO-2 country code. Last reviewed 2026-06-24 (Agent 4).

GR.instant_payments: IRIS 122.1m txns 2025 (+72.8% y/y); business acceptance mandatory since 2025-12-01
GR.implication: ATM count surging (deployers/Euronet IADs) while branches fall → off-site self-service + managed services; instant-payments boom → fraud/transaction monitoring (INETCO, FICO). Reconcile ATM jump vs HBA network data.

CY.implication: Flat branches, cash falling fast → cash-recycler/TCR demand at incumbents (Bank of Cyprus Glory TCR reference).

HR.implication: ECB ATM count noisy for HR — reconcile vs HNB card PDF. Branch + POS growth → acquiring (Nexi), recyclers (Erste HR OptiCash reference).

SI.instant_payments: SEPA SCT Inst (euro area); Flik instant
SI.implication: Stable ATMs, contracting branches → branch-substitution self-service + recyclers via Bankart (POS/TMS).

SK.implication: Deposit-ATM expansion + branch decline → recyclers/ATM 2.0 coin; strong POS growth → acquiring; OptiCash/APTRA references.

BG.instant_payments: Euro changeover 01/01/2026 → euro-area instant (SEPA SCT Inst)
BG.implication: Post-euro ATM/CDM replacement cycle + steepest EU branch contraction → self-service backfill, recyclers; surging POS → acquiring.

RO.instant_payments: RoPay 2.0 instant scheme live (Sep 2025); QR at POS
RO.implication: POS estate exploding (BNR national figures run ahead of ECB) → terminals/acquiring/TMS; cash resilient + branch decline → recyclers + self-service.

HU.implication: Rare ATM growth from the 'ATM in every settlement' mandate (Act XVIII) → rural ATM managed-services/recycling economics; sharp branch cuts → self-service.

CZ.instant_payments: CERTIS instant (CZK); SEPA SCT Inst for euro
CZ.implication: Gentle ATM decline + steepest footprint cash-withdrawal fall → cash-optimisation (OptiCash) + shared deposit-ATM network → recyclers; KAL incumbency (Česká spořitelna).
